Our Engagement Model

The Quality Assurance Engagement Timeline

A structured, six-phase engagement that takes your organization from current state to certified — with full transparency at every step.

01

Discovery & Scoping

Weeks 1–2

We conduct structured interviews with your key stakeholders, review existing documentation, and map your current state against target frameworks. Output: scoping report and project charter.

Stakeholder interview summaryAs-is compliance mapProject charter & timeline
02

Gap Assessment

Weeks 3–5

A comprehensive gap analysis across all applicable control domains. We quantify gaps by severity, effort, and risk impact — giving you a clear picture of where you stand.

Gap assessment reportRisk-prioritized gap registerRemediation roadmap
03

Remediation & Implementation

Weeks 6–16

We work alongside your team to close gaps systematically — drafting policies, building controls, configuring tooling, and training personnel on new processes.

Policy & procedure libraryControl implementation evidenceTraining completion records
04

Internal Audit & Validation

Weeks 17–19

We perform an internal audit simulation against the target framework, identify any remaining gaps, and remediate before the formal audit window.

Internal audit reportResidual risk summaryPre-audit remediation log
05

Formal Audit Support

Weeks 20–22

Idatum serves as your liaison with external auditors — managing evidence requests, fielding technical inquiries, and ensuring a smooth audit experience.

Evidence packageAuditor correspondence logFinal audit debrief
06

Ongoing Monitoring & Advisory

Continuous

Post-certification, we remain engaged through quarterly reviews, continuous control monitoring, and annual readiness assessments to protect your certification status.

Quarterly compliance reviewsContinuous monitoring reportsAnnual readiness assessment
